subject: NovaMed — Security architecture review & evidence kickoff
messages:
From: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@novamed.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Kickoff: security architecture review and evidence list request

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for making time — NovaMed is preparing for a vendor security review next month and our procurement team has asked us to get a technical deep-dive with your engineering/security leads to map required artifacts. We want this session to cover: SSO/SAML details, key management / encryption-at-rest, audit log locations & formats, and an initial SOC 2 evidence checklist for the services we plan to use.

Target timeline: procurement would like a completed evidence list and architecture notes by 2026-08-12. Can we schedule a 60–75 minute architecture review this week or early next week? Our preferred windows are:
- Wed Jul 29: 10:00–12:00 ET
- Thu Jul 30: 14:00–16:00 ET
- Mon Aug 3: morning ET

Attendees from our side: Amira Hassan (security lead), Luke Mercer (platform ops), and the procurement lead (security@novamed.com).

I can share a draft evidence matrix before the call — attaching our initial inventory (see: SOC2_prepare_v0.xlsx) — and we can walk through required owners and timelines.

Thanks,
Amira
Security & Compliance
NovaMed Health Systems

Attachment: SOC2_prepare_v0.xlsx (stub)

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@novamed.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff: security architecture review and evidence list request

Hi Amira — thanks for the note and the matrix. Happy to run a focused architecture review. Proposed agenda (60–75 min):
1) Quick intros (5 min)
2) High-level service boundary and hosting model (10 min)
3) SSO/identity architecture + SAML metadata exchange (15 min)
4) Encryption (KMS & key rotation) and data-at-rest design (15 min)
5) Audit logging: what we emit, retention, how you can access (15 min)
6) Next steps & owners (5–15 min)

I’ve looped in Soojin (security engineer) and Mina (compliance lead) — they’ll own the tech and evidence mapping. Camila from solutions will join for any deployment/ops questions.

We can do Thu Jul 30 14:00–15:15 ET — that matches one of your windows. If that doesn’t work, Wed Jul 29 11:00–12:15 ET is our next best slot. Which do you prefer? Also: could you share the following ahead of the call so we can prepare concrete artifact owners?
- The list of NovaMed systems that will call Redwood APIs (names + team owners)
- Any SSO IdP metadata and whether you require Just-in-Time provisioning or SCIM
- Preferred retention period for audit logs (default is 90 days, configurable)

I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time and will attach our evidence matrix (SOC2_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx) and a redacted network diagram.

—Jordan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOC2_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (will attach), network_diagram.pdf (stub)

From: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@novamed.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Luke Mercer <l.mercer@novamed.com>, security@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff: security architecture review and evidence list request

Thanks Jordan — Thu Jul 30 14:00–15:15 ET works best for us. Please send an invite. A few quick clarifications so we have a clean agenda: 

- Our scope: two internal applications (billing.novamed.com and intake.novamed.com) will call your hosted API; both teams will own the integration. I’ll send a short ownership spreadsheet by EOD.
- SSO: we use Okta; we will share SAML metadata and plan to use SCIM for user sync.
- Audit logs: we maintain 1 year internally; for vendor logs we need at least 180 days export capability. Can you confirm Redwood can provide log export and a signed attestation for retention?

We’re also hoping to cover encryption key custody briefly — we expect customer-managed keys (BYOK) for PHI, if supported. If BYOK isn’t an option in the hosted plan, please let us know alternatives.

I’ve attached the procurement inventory we mentioned.

Appreciate it — Amira

Attachment: NovaMed_procurement_inventory_v1.xlsx (stub)

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@novamed.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Kickoff: security architecture review and evidence list request

Hi Amira — I’ll be on the call Thu 7/30. A few notes so we can keep the session efficient: 

- Please paste the minimal SAML metadata (entityID + ACS URL) or attach the XML file; we don’t need Okta admin access before the call.
- For BYOK/CMK: our hosted tier supports envelope encryption with customer KMS (AWS KMS) via a managed integration; we’ll prepare a short slide and an example key policy. If you use a non-AWS KMS we’ll need to discuss connectivity options.
- Audit logs: Redwood can export logs in JSON/NDJSON with signed digests for integrity. Default retention is 90 days — we can provide export hooks and an S3 push for 180+ day retention. We’ll bring sample log format and a short export guide.

I’m attaching a lightweight checklist we’ll fill during the call so we can assign owners. Also adding a link to our internal evidence playbook for pre-read: https://drive.redwood.com/s/3q8xN-evidence-playbook

—Soojin
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_evidence_checklist.docx (stub)

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@novamed.com>, Luke Mercer <l.mercer@novamed.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, security@novamed.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -0400
Subject: Confirmed: Thu Jul 30 14:00–15:15 ET — NovaMed security review (calendar invite)

Thanks everyone — invite sent for Thu 30 Jul 14:00–15:15 ET. Quick recap and pre-call asks: 

Action items for NovaMed (Amira / Luke):
- Send the small ownership spreadsheet (apps + owners) — Amira said EOD 7/28 (we have not yet received it).
- Attach SAML metadata XML or paste the entityID/ACS URL to the calendar thread.
- Confirm whether you require BYOK with non-AWS KMS or if AWS KMS is acceptable.

Action items for Redwood:
- Soojin: prepare BYOK slide + sample key policy.
- Mina: prepare SOC 2 evidence mapping for the hosted offering and highlight any gaps for PHI.
- Camila: bring deployment runbook notes.

Attachments included on the invite: SOC2_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx, network_diagram.pdf (redacted). We plan to record the session for internal notes — let me know if you prefer we don’t record.

If there are additional stakeholders (legal, procurement, or the data protection officer) you want on the call, please add them to the invite. Looking forward to it.

—Jordan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (attached), network_diagram.pdf (attached)
